evals.name: convert-claude-to-plugin
evals.prompt: I've got a few slash commands and a code-review agent in my project's .claude/ folder that I want to share with my team. Turn them into a Claude Code plugin I can host on our GitHub org. Show me the exact directory layout, the plugin.json, and how my teammates would install it.
evals.expected_output: A correct plugin structure with .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name required), commands/ and agents/ at the plugin ROOT, a marketplace.json for GitHub hosting, and namespaced install instructions.
expectations: commands/ and agents/ directories are at the plugin root, NOT inside .claude-plugin/
A marketplace.json (or a github plugin source) is provided so the plugin can be hosted on GitHub
Install instructions use /plugin marketplace add <owner/repo> and /plugin install <name>@<marketplace>, and note that plugin skills/commands are namespaced

evals.name: build-mcp-skill-plugin
evals.prompt: Create a Claude Code plugin called db-tools that bundles an MCP server (a node script at servers/index.js) and a skill for writing database migrations. Give me the full directory layout and the files I need, including plugin.json and the MCP configuration.
evals.expected_output: Plugin root with .claude-plugin/plugin.json, skills/<name>/SKILL.md, and .mcp.json referencing servers/index.js via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. Components at plugin root.
expectations: plugin.json is at .claude-plugin/plugin.json with name db-tools
A skill exists as skills/<name>/SKILL.md with a description in its frontmatter
An MCP configuration (.mcp.json or mcpServers in plugin.json) is provided that runs servers/index.js
The MCP server command/args path uses ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} instead of an absolute or hard-coded path
All component directories are at the plugin root, not inside .claude-plugin/

evals.name: marketplace-and-versioning
evals.prompt: How do I set up a plugin marketplace so my team automatically gets our plugins when they open the repo, and how do versioning and updates actually work? We push changes often.
evals.expected_output: Explains .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, extraKnownMarketplaces + enabledPlugins for auto-prompting, version resolution (bump explicit version vs omit for commit-SHA), and /plugin marketplace update.
expectations: Explains the marketplace catalog file at .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
Shows extraKnownMarketplaces (and enabledPlugins) in project .claude/settings.json so teammates are auto-prompted when they trust the repo
States that an explicit version in plugin.json must be bumped on every release or users won't receive updates
Given frequent pushes, recommends omitting version so the git commit SHA is used and every commit counts as an update
Mentions /plugin marketplace update (or auto-update) to refresh the marketplace
